admission.justification: Guarded by test_server_info_compacts_large_running_servers_and_retains_full_list_in_log and prevents large running-server fleets from overflowing the inline server_info answer and dropping checkoutBinding, openUserSettings, or agentBinding.

applicability: Every MCP server_info tool answer built by mcp/tools/core.py::server_info_payload.
conditions: The running-server registry returns zero or more live server records.
exclusions: The full validated ServerInfoResponse persisted in the daily tool log.
statement: server_info projects runningServers inline as a compact summary holding count, staleCount, roles, and at most five recent entries while retaining the full runningServers list in the validated payload and daily tool log.
title: server_info compacts runningServers inline while logging full list
